summary: Gwinnett County tower on a Georgia tower list (1,192 ft, 'topo 1964' note); no source found on its build, condition or access.

events.note: The tnlandforms list gives the note 'topo 1964' without explaining it. Tower 60 is in the list's USGS name-database group (1-72), so the note may date a map rather than construction; the list gives no build date.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one tower list with coordinates, elevation and a 1964 note; one independent list with only the name; one DOT plan label with no date visible in the cached text. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Georgia lists. No build date, height, design, agency, status or access found. The 1964 note is not explained by the list. Reading it as a map date is an inference, and it is weaker here than for discovered towers because tower 60 is in the 1-72 name-database group. The story runs about 160 words; the sources are thin, so nothing is padded. Gwinnett Historical Society archive pages appeared in search results but were not read. Not verified on the ground.
